balls.text: Bouncer on leg, Rinku looks to ramp but is beaten. It's a dot to close out the innings, but KKR have finished with a flourish courtesy the mighty Dre Russ and Rinku Singh!
Low full toss on leg this time and Rinku adjusts to flick it over square leg. Seems to have hit the rope on the full. And indeed it has! Six more for Rinku!
Hammered into the stands! 200 up for KKR with two legal balls left. This is a low full toss outside off and Rinku uses his wrists to whip it over midwicket
Pulled into the gap! Short on leg at 135kph, he stands tall and hammers it between deep midwicket and long-on
Rinku looks to take on this short ball but ends up lobbing it just back over the umpire off a top edge. They do take two, so Rinku will take strike again

Lands safe! But more importantly for RR, it's just a single! Russell takes on this attempted wide yorker. Ends up getting it off the toe end and the ball goes high in the air but falls in no-man's land between cover and long-off converging
A hat-trick of wides now from Madhwal!
Madhwal goes wide of the tramline again as he sticks to the plan to bowl wide yorkers
Looks to go for the wide yorker, but goes past the tramline

Dropped at long-off! This is a 147.3kph low full toss on middle, Russell looks to go downtown and launches it straight of long-off. Parag runs to his left and dives, but can't hold on. Two drops for the RR skipper now. This one could be more costly than the last
Pulled in front of square! Slower bouncer outside off, Russell waits on it and swivels and pummels it away along the ground

You don't bowl full tosses at Russell! 22-ball fifty for him! This is a full toss on leg and Russell adjusts quickly and ends up just flicking it over square leg. At 148kph, I am sure this would be a tough ball to put away for a lot of batters, but not for the big man Dre Russ
Brilliant from Archer! 149kph yorker on leg. Russell does well to squeeze it back out
Rinku is quick to tuck the ball out through midwicket to get Russell on strike

Holes out at deep square leg! This is a back of the hand slower ball on a length on leg. Raghuvanshi looks to help it over behind square leg but the lack of pace does him in. Easy grab for the substitute fielder Ashok Sharma
New ball, same result! This is what Andre Russell can do in full flow! This is tossed too full outside off and Russell launches it over long-off
Massive, massive six! Russell is giving the crowd what they wanted! This is short outside off again and Russell frees his arms and smokes it down the ground!
Russ has his eye in now! This looked like a seam-up delivery from Theekshana and it's short and wide and Russell hammers it over cow corner
Sliced in the air but this time it drops safely! Tossed up wide and Raghuvanshi wanted to go down the ground again. Ends up lobbing the ball into the vacant mid-off region

Chance goes begging! This is on a yorker length on off and Raghuvanshi ends up chipping it towards long-off. Parag is running in from long-off but doesn't judge it correctly and the ball ends up away from his body as he looks to catch it
Tossed wide of off, Raghuvanshi looks for the big slog sweep but it spins away to beat bat
Archer fires in a bouncer around off and Russell has to duck out of the way!
Raghuvanshi drops this length ball to his right for a single to get Russell back on strike for the last ball of this Archer over
On a length outside off, Russell looks to pull and gets it off the toe end to deep midwicket
Russell lofts Archer down the ground again! This is a slot ball on off and Russell goes straight and over the umpire. This time, though, he will have to settle for four
Hammered over long-on! Low full toss on leg, he gets his front foot out of the way and picks the bones out of this one. Archer can only watch it sail back over his head
Full around middle and off, clipped through midwicket for a single

Slower bouncer outside off, Russell looks to uppercut it but is beaten. Russell reviews this for a wide not given. Russell was deep in his crease and on his toes when he tried to hit that, and it does look like it go above his head even then. Ball tracking coming up now. Ah, that's just under Russell's head height so the decision is upheld

Slapped away through cover point! The Dre Russ show is well and truly on! On a length and outside off, Russell reaches out and crunches it away. Two runs off his first nine balls. Now 14 off the next three!
This time the connection is clean as a whistle! This is in the slot and Russell clears his front leg and mows this over cow corner
And there he goes! This is full around middle, he looks to heave it leg side. Doesn't get all of it but gets it in the gap at square leg
Madhwal starts off to him with a bouncer outside off, but Russell leaves it alone. No wide called, though
Full toss outside off, close to the body, and Raghuvanshi can only push it out towards cover for a single
On a length around middle, Russell defends again
Pulls this short-ish ball to wide long-on
Watch out, Dre Russ! Russell has to duck out of the way as Raghuvanshi smashes a half-volley right over him and beats long-on
Tossed up on a yorker length around off, squeezed back out to the bowler
Dropped short-ish on off and Raghuvanshi pulls it wide of long-on. Good stop by Archer
On a length around off, punched down the ground to long-on
Theekshana goes shorter outside off and Russell hammers a cut, but straight to the off side sweeper
Oh beauty! It's another carrom ball and it goes past the forward defensive shot offered by Russell
Beaten by the legbreak! It's the carrom ball, actually and it spins away to beat the outside edge as Russell prods at it
Darted in on off, Russell stays back and defends
Tossed up fuller outside off, driven out to sweeper cover
Legbreak on a length around off, pushed towards cover and he wants a single, but he's sent back
Now, that's more like him! Parag tosses this wide and Russell has a big swing at it! He doesn't find anything but thin air though!
That's something you rarely see from Andre Russell! This is quick and full around middle, and Dre Russ brings out a textbook front-foot defence!
He's nicked it! Rahane goes for the sweep on this full ball on middle going across him and ends up getting a tickle and it's gobbled up. Finger goes up immediately
Parag now tosses this up wide of and ends up going too wide
Driven out to deep cover
Rahane looks to drive down the ground and ends up chipping it into the vacant mid-on area as the bottom hand comes off
On a length around middle, Raghuvanshi hangs back and clips it out to deep midwicket
Tossed full on leg, swept out to deep square leg
Hasaranga drops it short and Raghuvanshi rocks back to pull this in the gap between deep midwicket and long-on! This wasn't a half-tracker but Raghuvanshi pounces on it
Tossed up full outside off, Rahane gets down to sweep and gets it past backward square off the inside half of the bat
Slides this down leg as Rahane misses his sweep. Called wide
Full outside off, tapped through cover for a single
Skips out to this length ball and hits it out to deep midwicket
On a length around off, it's the legbreak and Raghuvanshi clips it through midwicket for a single
Dropped short on off, Rahane pulls it along the ground to deep midwicket's left, but Hetmyer does well to save two runs
On a length on middle, clipped behind square leg
This is too wide and allows Raghuvanshi to free his arms and crash it through cover!
Floated up outside off, Raghuvanshi hits a lofted drive wide of long-off. They get two
Tossed up fuller and Rahane sweeps off the toe end to deep midwicket
Tucks this length ball through square leg
Good shout for lbw. Height might be the issue. Was a quicker length ball around off that beat the sweep
Tossed up again, this time Raghuvanshi manufactures power with the slog sweep. Just cleared the in-field, long leg was in place and was beaten to the left
Almost clips the stumps after beating the pull. Ball popped off the keeper's leg to Theekshana at short fine leg. Rahane tried to pull that and looked to have been beaten for pace
Tucked off the back foot behind square
Short, might've been slower. 81ks again. Line just outside off, punched to cover off the back foot. High bat-swing too
Not that short but it was slow and sat up. 81ks. Landed on middle and spun away, Rahane went deep in the crease and pulled hard. Got it to deep square leg on the bounce
Touch short. 97ks on top of leg, Rahane helps it to deep fine leg with the ball. Goes to him on the bounce. Timeout.
Full on the pads, 96ks, swept to short fine leg
A bit of room on this length ball, Rahane steers it off the back foot to deep point
Flicked off the back foot, to midwicket this time. Another length ball on leg
Goes back and clips the length ball to deep midwicket
Length on leg, clipped to deep-backward square
Flat and quick, length on fifth, tapped to short third
Length at the stumps, clipped off the back foot to the bowler's right

Overthrows, flat throw from deep point . Jaiswal side-armed it flat as Archer was running in from the other end and ducked. Was a touch too wide for the keeper. Was a fullish quick ball on fourth that was punched with an open face

Slog swept flat and straight to Hetmyer at deep midwicket. Theekshana gets Gurbaz for the fifth time. Was a length ball around fourth, Gurbaz got on one knee and timed it decently. No, square-on replay shows it came off the bottom of the bat
Fuller side of length on leg, 103ks, flicked to long leg
Shortish ball on middle, might've been seam-up, pulled to deep-backward square

Plumb if he's not hit it. Jurel, Parag and Hasaranga have a chat. No review. This was the first into-the-pitch dart of the over, slightly short and zipped off the pitch. Rahane cleared the front leg, back leg was deep in the crease as he tried to flick it through square leg. Ultra-Edge shows there was an inside edge
Goes back and tucks the 88ks length ball to long-off
Fifty partnership up with the second sweep of the over. This is off middle stump and off the sticker, deep fine leg ran right and slid but couldn't parry t in
Given a lot of air. 88ks lands just outside the crease, no drift though, nudged through midwicket
Flicks the full slow ball through the leg side

Swept fine, might've been off the glove.. Through where leg slip would've been. Was a full legbreak around leg, Gurbaz got across and on one knee to try and go behind square. Perhaps not that fine but he'll take it
On the pads, Rahane doesn't move this time. Flicks the low full toss through square leg, deep backward square's close but has no chance

Just chipped over the bowler. Gentle drive with the straight-bat drive extending just around thigh but the timing was perfect. Was a full ball following Rahane, he was in close to the leg-side tramline and hit it from right in front of him
Gurbaz goes across off side this time. Crouches and looks to pick up the 135ks length ball over fine leg, misses. Ball pops off the left thigh to short fine

Makes room and slogs, mid-on's in play but it doesn't carry. Kunal there moved to the right and slid diagonally after his knee hit the ground, the ball hit is wrist and he looks to be in pain. Walking off in fact. Was a full ball well down leg because Gurbaz had made a lot of room, he tried to clear mid-on with a low, horizontal swipe
Yorker on leg, 138ks, didn't look as quick though. Rahane slides leg side and jams a check-punch to mid-on
Five metres either side, that'd have been four. Finds short fine leg instead. Gurbaz had pulled the 135ks back of length ball at the body late, timed it well too
Yorker length outside off, 108ks, guided to short third
Makes room and drives the low full toss on middle hard. Finds mid-off

No one behind square leg side, so Gurbaz manufactures a late sweep. Went across to fourth stump and waited for the 106ks length ball to get right below his his eyes, kinda shovelled his bat without extending his arms fully to get it fine
Shin-high full toss follows Gurbaz as he makes room. Was well down leg as he nudged it along the ground through midwicket
Full on leg, 106ks, may have drifted in a bit. Flicked to long-on
Gurbaz looks to take him on first ball, cloths it to long-on. Was a wide shortish ball that was flat, Gurbaz tried to flat-bat it probably between the deep fielders

Flogged across over midwicket. Much squarer than Gurbaz's pull. Picked up off a fuller side of length from outside off. 141ks, The ball came off at an even pace off the pitch despite being a cross-seamer
Bunts the fifth-stump length ball to cover for a quick single

Pulled well in front of midwicket, aerial too. Fully in control this time. One bounce four to the longer side. Was a hard-length ball on fifth, Gurbaz standing in the crease and hitting it with a swirl of the hips
Punches the fullish ball in the channel to mid-off

Top edge takes a horizontal-bat hack over the first slip area. Gurbaz went across to fourth stump before the hard-length ball was delivered, he was deep in the crease and got a bit of width. Tried to hit it across to square leg, gets some not-in-control runs
Pulls an off-stump length ball to square leg. Played with the bat face looking into the ground. 139ks.
Quick single towards point. Three-quarter length on off, Gurbaz defends with soft hands and an angled bat
Looks to glance the length ball on leg, misses and gets it off the thigh pad through fine leg. 144ks
Beaten on the ramp. Rahane looking to use the 144ks on that bouncer over middle and off, he stood beside the ball and limboed to get into a good position. Just couldn't make contact
Gurbaz takes guard outside leg and walks across to middle to glance the 148ks fullish ball around middle, to deep fine leg
Past the attempted hook. Pacy back of lengther from Archer, angling just down leg. There was deep fine leg in place
Slow and full on off, defended back to the bowler. 122ks
Looks to whip the full ball off the pads, misses

Trims the bails with an offcutter. Narine cleared the front leg and looked to launch the length ball over square leg. The arc of the bat was almost from point to square leg, so it was proper across the line. He played the wrong line and was into the shot too early. Ball tracking shows that deviated away a touch. Narine grimaces as he walks back, Yudhvir joins in hands and looks up in celebration
Into Narine's wheelhouse. Anything in his half, he just swats mercilessly as he does here. Made room, got a slot ball following him and flicked it flat over backward square leg for a 62-metre six
Bumper over leg, let go. Called wide on height
Yudhvir looks to follow Narine but the length ball is on the pads, Narine raises the front leg and glances it uppishly. Not too far from short fine leg but finds the gap
Yudhvir goes proper bouncer this time. 131ks but looked pacy. Went above Narine's left shoulder as he swayed away
Makes room again and has an open-hip heave, toes the length ball on off to midwicket. Hit into the ground by Narine
Length ball is slow off the pitch, Narine swipes and misses. That went over the stumps, Narine made room and looked to go over square leg
Length on fifth, punched to cover point

145ks bouncer. Not sure if Archer saw Gurbaz make room and dance down but it was the perfect response to the premeditated movement. Gurbaz sways his head out the way while going for the pull. Gets beaten
Overpitched on leg, flicked to deep square leg. Sun breaks out as they complete the run. 144ks
Angles it away off a length through fifth. Looked to have been away movement off the pitch. Let go
Pitched up again. On leg stump, Narine showed all his stumps and was beside the line of the ball. Blocked it back to the bowler. 140ks
Swings in first up. Gets the yorker, Gurbaz takes a couple of small steps in front and gets yorked actually, punched from fourth stump to cover for a quick single

Vaibhav nails the yorker, Dubey digs it out to long-off, can they get the second? NO! The throw is quick from Rinku, and Vaibhav takes the stumps off with Archer well short! KKR are very much alive in IPL 2025! Rinku Singh raced in from long-off and was sharp with his throw, and that seals the win in regular time for KKR! Rajasthan Royals almost pulled off a dramatic win for the ages. Sreshth says Rinku was swapped from long-on to long-off as a late call by Rahane!
Six down the ground! It's a full toss outside off and Dubey goes straight and long!
Dubey is keeping Royals alive here! Full on the stumps and he is able to whip it away behind square. Russell running to his right from deep fine leg can't stop it!
Dubey nails this! Short outside off and he is able to pull this away over deep backward square!
Yorker outside off, Archer looks to drive it out on the off side and can only deflect it to short third off the toe end of the bat
Full outside off, drilled out to deep cover where Rinku Singh does very well to stop it with a dive to his right

Inswinging yorker around middle, Archer inside edges it onto his boot. The ball rolls to the right of the stumps and Russell tries to race Dubey to the non-striker's end to kick the ball onto the stumps, but he misses with that effort using the outside of his foot. Neat football skills, but he's just missed the mark by a little
Low full toss on leg, Archer looks to swing this away but it goes square off the inside edge with the ball also deflecting off his pads. They are able to run two
Goes for the wide yorker, it's just slightly short of that mark, and Archer is able to drill this through cover! RR's first boundary in 21 balls!
Yorker outside off, Dubey jams his bat down but it's gone straight to the off side sweeper. No luck for Royals right now!
Full outside off, Dubey drills it wide of long-off but Rinku is rapid to run to his right and stop that and get the throw in. Rahane applauds his efforts there
Goes for the yorker, but it's a low full toss that's swinging into Archer, who can only inside edge it onto his pads
Pace off length ball outside off, Archer steers it to short third and gets a quick single
Another slower ball brings KKR another dot! This is wide, on a length and it beats Archer's outside edge

Parag holes out five short of a maiden T20 century! This is an offcutter on a length outside off and Parag looks to go down the ground. But he hits this flat and it goes straight to Vaibhav Arora who does the rest. A stunning knock, but he looks supremely disappointed

Big appeal as Dubey misses this full ball speared in from outside off. He's hit around the thigh. There's also a run out chance as Gurbaz had a shy at the striker's end with Parag racing in. A direct hit would have sent the RR skipper running straight back to the dugout
That's great stuff from Harshit! This pace off length ball outside off stays low and seams in to beat Dubey's swing
Yorker outside off, drilled down to long-off
Full outside off, Dubey looks to swing it leg side and it goes off the inside half to deep midwicket on the bounce
Driven down to long-off

Doesn't carry to the fielder at deep midwicket! This spins in and Parag looks to mow it over midwicket, but doesn't get the distance and elevation. Rinku runs in from the boundary and dives forward but it lands just short ofh im
Dubey tucks this off his pads to backward square leg for a single
On a length on off and it spins away sharply as Dubey pushes at it!
Offbreak spins in from a length outside off, Parag works it with the spin to deep midwicket
Tucks this length ball off his pads to short fine leg for a quick single
Full outside off, Dubey eases it through point

And that's the breakthrough! The short ball does the trick! Banged in short on leg, Hetmyer looks to pull and gets a top edge that loops up to short third! Hetmyer, though has reviewed this! Did that hit him on the helmet? The bat was close to the helmet. But the UltraEdge does confirm that there was a spike as ball went past bat so Hettie has to go. A big blow just when Royals were the team with momentum behind them
Full around off, whipped away to deep midwicket
Full on off and going across, punched out through cover
Bouncer outside leg, Hetmyer looks to swivel and hook but it's gone down leg
Driven down to long-on

Oh, that's gone through both fielders! This is on a length outside off and Parag punches it past the cover fielder to his left. Rinku, the off side sweeper, runs to his left and dives, and does stop it but but can't push it out from under him and the ball rolls onto the boundary rope

Hetmyer misses a slog sweep and KKR go up in appeal immediately! This was angled across him and spinning further away. Gurbaz is convinced, so is Narine. KKR review it. The third umpire concludes there's a clear gap between bat and ball so the decision stands
Carrom ball on a length outside off, tucked through midwicket
On a length and angled across him, punched out to the off side sweeper
Slogged over midwicket! Hetmyer joins the party now as he takes on this slot ball on off. Royals on a roll here
Tossed full around off, Parag works it down to long-on
Tucks this length ball outside off through square leg and they scamper for two

Full outside leg, Hetmyer clips it through midwicket and they are running two. The throw is in at the striker's end while Hetmyer is getting back and he turns away covering his head as it was a pretty fast throw! No one hurt in the end, though
Tossed up full, Parag drives it out to long-off
On a length outside off, he looks to defend and it hits the inside half of the bat
Full outside off, Parag drills a drive to cover
Six sixes off the last six legal deliveries Parag has faced! This is full outside off, but Parag gets in position early and reverse-sweeps this bever backward point!
Fossed full outside off, driven out to wide long-off
Five sixes in a row! This is full and wide and Parag lofts this over long-off. Stunning stuff from Parag!
Moeen looks to take it away from his hitting arc and ends up going too wide
Four in a row! This is a bit short and angled across him. Parag stands tall and smokes this over long-on! That's hit the car on display there!
Hat-trick of sixes! In the slot outside leg and Parag whips it over square leg again
Launched over long-on now! This is tossed up full and wide and Parag frees his arms and goes downtown
Smoked over deep square leg! Parag brings up his maiden fifty of the season in style! This is in the slot on leg and Parag whips it away. A muted celebration from the RR captain
Tossed full on middle, Hetmyer tucks it through square leg and gets a single
Misfield! Low full toss outside off, Hetmyer drives it square and Harshit Rana lets it slip through. Anukul Roy in the deep does well to stop the boundary
Slower bouncer outside off, he pulls it square off the bottom half of the bat. It's in the gap so they get two
Yorker around off, dug out to long-on
Parag on a roll here! This is low full toss outside off and Parag lofts it back over the bowler
Hammered past long-off! This is overpitched outside off and Parag drills it straight of the fielder!
Low full toss outside off, Parag laces a drive to cover's right
Hetmyer looks to flick this away but misses. It's on a length around leg and hits him on the pads
Full on middle, worked through midwicket
Floated full around off, Hetmyer chips it wide of long-on, but it drops short of the two deep fielders coming together
On a length outside off, Parag hangs back and whips it out to deep midwicket
On a length outside off, driven out to cover
Crunched down the ground! This is tossed up full outside off and Hetmyer smacks it right back past the bowler
Beaten. Parag tried to use the pace and angle to run it towards third. Was a length ball on fifth that got good bounce
Flatter yorker on off, drills it hard to long-off's left. A bit of hesitation in the running, throw at the non-striker's requested by the keeper. It does come but Hetmyer was easily in
Full on middle, 96ks, flicked to deep midwicket
Length outside off, steered to sweeper cover

Leading edge pops towards cover, lands well in front of him. Hetmyer yells in frustration likely because he mistimed it. Was a shortish ball that landed down leg and went away to off, Hetmyer tried to clip it through square leg off the back foot
Full on off, flicked along the ground to long-on's left
Inside edges the back-foot cover drive. Ball rolls towards square leg. Length ball around fourth, got good bounce. Timeout taken
Full on leg, 91ks, flicked to deep midwicket
Length on leg, 92ks, beats the back foot flick and hits the top of the pad
Pats the length ball to long-off
Cuts it off a length to deep point
Full outside off, looks to drive through cover. Gets it to short third
Length on fourth, punched off the back foot to long-on

Another googly to deck off stump. Two in the over. Just 86ks, on a length, landed around fourth and zipped off the pitch. Turned a bit, not all that much, Hasaranga seemed to have played down the wrong line and was beaten on the inside edge as he tried to drive through cover. Our scorers think the opposite though, Ranjith says this turned more than Jurel's
Fullish on fourth, looks to defend to cover. Inside edges it onto the pitch before it rolls towards square leg

Spins in and knocks off into ground. First-baller for Jurel. He did not read the googly. 93ks on a length, landed around fifth and came back in sharply, Jurel tried to defend to cover, he then tried to jam the bat onto pad but it was too late by then. Varun leaps in delight
Length on leg, clipped to deep midwicket
Almost a chop-on. Parag looked to drive hard through cover, but the 95ks topspinner on fifth took the inside edge and went past leg stump

'Catch' is the call... taken at long-on. Moeen gets another left-hander. Rinku runs in, takes it low and slides nicely. Was a floaty 91ks full ball on fifth, Jaiswal crossed his feet, got low and looked to thrash it across.
Similar ball, cut to deep point
Tight call for wide. Given. Gurbaz disagrees. KKR won't review though. Was a length ball that landed close to the tramline and was left alone
Length on leg, clipped to deep midwicket
Whipped off the back foot this time, finds long-on
Clipped softly between long-on and deep midwicket for a smartly placed couple. Was a 100ks length ball on leg
Full on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Wide on a length, 114ks, cut hard. Finds deep point
Length on fifth, punched to cover
Ramped fine, one bounce over the deep-third boundary. Halfway ball around shoulder-height at fourth stump, Jaiswal crouched a bit, swayed back and lifted the bat up beside his left shoulder

Slower one is picked up and flayed over mid-off. Off the bottom of the bat but cleared the infield easy. Lot of surface area to connect too as that was horizontal bat. Was a wide ball on the fuller side of length
Cut off a length. Fourth-stump too, Jaiswal trusting the bounce and bashing it to point's left
Much like Varun's last ball. Length on off, 118ks, cut to backward point.
Length at the stumps, flicked to deep midwicket
112ks seam-up. On a spinner's length at fifth stump, Jaiswal goes for another cut but is beaten by pace. Ball pops out of Gurbaz's glove too. Landed in front
Touch short at the stumps, hits the bat high as Jaiswal tries to clip it leg side, off the back foot
Premeditates the reverse sweep, connects too. Clears backward point with ease. Was a length ball on off, Jaiswal switched his stance but not his great, drove it through with power
This is around a fuller side of length but the bounce is so good that Jaiswal was able to cut it through point. Was standing inside the crease, cleared the front foot to make a bit of room
Length on fourth, good bounce, worked off the back foot to midwicket
Length on leg, flicked to short fine leg
Down leg again, Parag looks to whip it. Gets a thinnish edge. Gurbaz hopped sideways a couple of times before diving left but couldn't lay glove on it
Fullish ball is defended to the leg side
Makes room and flashes, edge goes over short third. Clears the boundary cushion too in fact. Was a length ball around fourth, Parag looked to go over cover but got it off the bottom
Slower full ball is down leg and goes past the leg glance
Flicked beautifully over midwicket. On the squarer side, Parag stood upright and flicked it uppishly. Cleared the infield with a short-arm backlift
Pitched up on leg, clipped to midwicket
Width offered and Jaiswal lashes it over long-off. He stood still, wound back and had a heave. Was a fullish ball around sixth
Wide and full, driven to cover
Length at the stumps, clipped to deep square leg
Works the full ball around fourth to mid-on
Leg-stump half-volley. Parag gets inside the line and whips it fine. Played late. Clears fine leg for a 73-metre six
Length on fifth, punched off the back foot to short cover
Length around middle, 88ks, clipped to deep midwicket

Taken at mid-on. No referral needed this time. Rathore reaches forward again and looks to launch it across the line. Looked to be too early on the fourth-stump length ball. Skied it to mid-on for a dolly

Hard sweep beaten. Lbw appeal from KKR has been turned down. They will review. Think this might be umpire's call clipping leg. Was a length ball to which Rathore reached far forward and hit square. Ultra-Edge not available but third umpire happy that ball missed bat. Was a length ball on off that hit hit the left-edge of the front knee-roll. It is in fact clipping the edge of leg stump.
Hits the sticker, ball pops on the bounce to cover. Was a 90ks length ball outside off, Jaiswal reached far forward and looked to drive it from well in front of the body. Was late to check the shot
Shorter but the 90ks ball was driven into the pitch. Jaiswal makes room and clips off the back foot to midwicket
Top edge but that clears midwicket. Was a skied pull to a ball that was slightly short if anything
